business_overview.one_sentence: The group sells online tour guide products mainly through OTAs, travel agencies and its Lvji APP, and also sells customised tourism content.

segments.name: Online tour guides
segments.business_substance: Digital tour guide content sold through OTAs, Lvji APP and travel agencies.

segments.name: Customised content
segments.business_substance: Customised content for tourist attractions and cultural sites.

business_overview.revenue_model: End users pay OTAs in advance; OTAs settle with the group monthly or quarterly, usually with 45-day credit terms. Travel agencies pay in advance. Customised content is generally payable within 30 days after acceptance.
business_notes: Revenue from OTA online tour guides was RMB485.922 million, 92.5% of total revenue.
The number of developed online tour guides increased to 75,943 in 2024 from 60,147 in 2023.
Large additions to copyrights are capitalised as intangible assets and are central to cash profit quality.

non_recurring_items.item: fair value gain on embedded derivative component of convertible bonds
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash fair value gain linked to convertible bonds.

non_recurring_items.item: overprovision in prior years tax reversal
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Prior-year tax expense reversal after tax clearance of a deregistered subsidiary.

funds_assets.item: cash at bank and on hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Group bank cash; mainly RMB-denominated bank balances.
Deposits pledged to government authorities for tourist-related business in the PRC.
Cash after deducting pledged bank deposits.
Cash held by the listed holding company.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, note 33, Company statement of financial position

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from OTAs and other customers; OTA credit term generally 45 days.
Primarily capitalised copyrights for online tour guide content.

investment_assets.business_substance: Prepayment to acquire non-performing debts through Anhui Assets and Equity Exchange process; not treated as readily detachable cash.

other_assets.item: current prepayments, deposits and other receivables
other_assets.business_substance: Operating prepayments, deposits, contract costs and other receivables net of ECL.
Related-party receivables; not a cash equivalent.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, statement of financial position and note 30(b)

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Unsecured bank loans guaranteed by group companies, a director and a related company; all shown as current because part contains a repayable-on-demand clause.
Amortised cost debt component of convertible bonds issued in 2024.
Derivative component of convertible bonds, fair valued through profit or loss.
Office lease liabilities; treated as operating continuity burden rather than direct detachable-cash debt deduction in the owner earnback result.

operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024, statement of financial position

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Includes RMB41.066 million other tax payable and RMB6.694 million financial liabilities at amortised cost.
Customer deposits for customised content; expected to settle within one year.

operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024, statement of financial position

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024, statement of financial position and note 30(b)

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow was much higher than profit in 2024, but the business capitalised RMB409.309 million of copyright additions, exceeding operating cash flow. The profit denominator therefore needs a large cash-profit haircut despite strong statutory operating cash flow.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2024, consolidated statement of profit or loss and note 6

gaps: The annual report does not split group cash by each operating subsidiary, VIE or dividend remittance path; PRC RMB cash was therefore heavily haircut.
Only 2024 annual report and 2023 comparative cash-flow details were extracted for operating cash flow and intangible additions; 2022 cash-flow details were not fully extracted.
The report does not disclose how much of annual copyright additions is maintenance versus growth capital expenditure.
